realistic_user_prompt: 我在证明一个新的图论命题：对满足条件 A 的所有有限连通图，不变量 I 都等于 2。现在找到一个带“隧道”结构的反例，结论失败，但我证明里列出的三个引理在这个例子上似乎都成立。团队有人建议直接把定理限制到“无隧道图”。请按拉卡托斯的证明—反驳方法诊断：这个反例属于什么类型，我应先找隐藏假设还是先加限制？请重构证明分析，提出候选隐藏引理，并设计能区分这些候选的下一轮反例。

trigger_cases.prompt: 我的定理碰到反例，但我不知道该改定理还是改证明。
形式证明器通过了，但实际模型给出反例，哪里可能出了问题？
这个定义为什么偏偏这样写？能从证明失败的地方解释它吗？
两个证明得出的假设范围不同，我该怎么比较？

negative_trigger_cases.prompt: 把这段中文翻译成英语。
柯西不等式的标准陈述是什么？
检查这个 Lean 证明脚本能否编译。
negative_trigger_cases.note: unless user asks methodological diagnosis of assumptions/formalization

method_selection_cases.condition: repeated safe restrictions unrelated to proof
formal derivation valid, intended example fails

failure_recovery_cases.recovery: infer provisional lemma graph; label inferred assumptions

failure_recovery_cases.failure: Formal proof passes but application fails

fresh_agent_simulation.expected_diagnosis: Global counterexample with no currently identified local failure; current proof analysis is incomplete. Do not immediately accept the unrelated “no tunnels” restriction.
expected_actions: expand each proof transformation into explicit dependencies
look for a hidden property whose failure is characteristic of the tunnel example
form at least two candidate hidden lemmas
design examples that preserve one candidate while violating the other
incorporate a condition only after it is tied to the proof dependency
state that the repaired theorem remains provisional
